description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and technically strong developers for the initiatives within our Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) Centre of Excellence. This role involves end-to-end development of innovative, high-impact projects involving blockchain infrastructure, digital assets, and enterprise-grade integrations. The ideal candidate will bring a balance of deep technical expertise skills to drive product delivery across emerging technologies and regulated environments.
  
  
The candidate must be a skilled professional who has E2E software development experience with a desire to work on an agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure. Must have hands-on experience in building applications to manage client journey and experience. They will be matured individuals who are comfortable working in an agile environment with critical peer reviews of design and code. They must be able to offer constructive critical reviews of other’s designs and code. They will be able to research, trial, and recommend new technologies of interest to the group. They will have experience with taking code through testing, deployment, and production.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Blockchain Platforms: Hands-on experience with permissioned blockchain frameworks such as Quorum, Hyperledger Besu, Hyperledger Fabric, and Corda, including provisioning, configuration, and orchestration.
* DLT Use Cases: Demonstrated understanding of DLT applications such as Real World Asset (RWA) tokenization, Cross-Border Payments, Decentralized Identity (DID), and smart contract-based financial products.
* Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in backend development using Python or Golang, Solidity, RESTful API design, and microservice architectures.
* DevOps & Deployment: Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. Proven track record deploying systems on AWS EKS or Azure AKS using CI/CD pipelines.
* Cryptography & Security: Knowledge of cryptographic primitives including public/private key infrastructure, symmetric/asymmetric encryption, digital signatures, and secure key management.
* System Integration: Ability to collaborate across platform, security, network, and compliance teams to ensure seamless integration of DLT services into enterprise ecosystems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Familiarity with AWS and/or Azure networking, access controls, high-availability setups, and infrastructure automation.

**Business**

* Build & maintain blockchain protocols, smart contracts, tokenization modules and consensus algorithms.
* Ensure security, integrity, and scalability of blockchain solutions.

* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in blockchain applications and systems.
* Suggest blockchain development processes and best practices.
* Perform code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, security, scalability, and adherence to coding standards.

**Processes**

* Solution Governance: Experience working with solution architects and security domain experts to design and implement systems compliant with internal controls, frameworks, and best practices.
* Standards & Methodologies: Proficiency in SDLC practices, Agile delivery, Git-based version control, issue tracking systems, and technical documentation.

**People & Talent**

* Leadership: Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams (Dev, DevOps, QA) through the full delivery lifecycle from ideation to implementation.
* Stakeholder Management: Comfortable interacting with business users, compliance, security, and external partners, aligning technical goals with business outcomes.
* Problem Solving: Adept at navigating ambiguity and delivering creative, robust solutions under tight deadlines and evolving requirements.
* Communication: Clear and persuasive communicator able to translate complex technical ideas into actionable insights for diverse audiences.
* Results-Driven: Strong track record of meeting delivery milestones while upholding code quality and security standards.
* Ability to coach and support junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

**Risk Management**

* The ability to interpret and align all responsible applications under the Groups technology and security framework, identify key issues based and put in place appropriate controls and measure.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. Promote and embed a culture of openness, trust and risk awareness where ethical, legal, regulatory and policy complaint conduct is the norm

**Governance**

* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, around infrastructure hosting and data management for client facing applications, and the regulatory requirements and expectations for the Bank. Ensure application design considerations are taken based on this.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. Promote and embed a culture of openness, trust and risk awareness where ethical, legal, regulatory and policy complaint conduct is the norm.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Skills And Experience**
Significant expertise in Core Java and J2EE technologies (e.g., Servlets, JSP, Spring, Hibernate).
  
  
Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Public Cloud (AWS/GCP), React UI
  
  
Strong proficiency with JavaScript frameworks, particularly React
  
  
Design and consume RESTful APIs and microservices

title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Owns complex system modules and fleet automation workflows; defines integration contracts across software, firmware, and hardware. Leads deep-dive investigations for incidents and hard faults; creates durable fixes and preventive controls. Designs performance, reliability, and fault-tolerance improvements for drivers, services, and provisioning pipelines at scale. Elevates code quality via reviews, patterns, and tooling; sets standards for observability, security, and compliance. Guides platform bring-up and diagnostics; collaborates with silicon, board, and firmware partners to validate end-to-end behavior. Designs and implements firmware components integrating diverse interfaces and protocols; diagnoses cross-domain issues (firmware/hardware/OS/ bootloaders) with logic analyzers, JTAG, and emulators; participates in schematic/board reviews; leads initial board/device bring-up; develops and debugs advanced features (e.g., RAS, high-speed I/O, chipset/SoC services) across ARM, AMD, Intel, and custom ASIC/FPGA platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Systems Software Development:**

* Design, develop, and maintain complex system software modules for managing, monitoring, and provisioning computer servers, storage, networking, and GPU subsystems in hyperscale environment.
* Utilizes advanced knowledge to design, develop, and deploy software layers and tooling to automate hardware provisioning and onboarding of servers to large-scale fleet.
* Play a significant role in platform bring-up, firmware updates, platform-level diagnostics, and complex cross-layer debugging.
* Diagnose and resolve complex issues across software, firmware, and hardware layers, working in DevOps and incident response paradigms to maintain reliability and availability.

**Software Development and Coding:**

* Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion.
* Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements.
* Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements.
* Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues.
* Develops fixes for identified issues.
* Implements comprehensive software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion.
* Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes.
* Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope.
* Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture.
* Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
* Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture.
* Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues.
* Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.
* Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.
* Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently.
* Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.
* Implements complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion.
* Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative.
* Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives.
* Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs.
* Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices.
* Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions.
* Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices.
* Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders.
* Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

We offer a portfolio of over six products, including established offerings like Magnum with over 60 active clients worldwide, and innovative products such as UW Ease. We function as a software house within Swiss Re, bringing together more than 150 technical professionals with multidisciplinary skills across multiple countries to deliver multi-regional, highly available solutions that transform the insurance industry.
  
  
**About You**
You're a technical expert with extensive experience who thrives in collaborative environments and excels at solving complex problems. You combine deep technical knowledge with leadership abilities, confidently guiding development teams while continuously advancing your own skills. You have a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale applications and are passionate about software craftsmanship. We understand that nobody meets 100% of requirements, so if you're passionate about software development and cloud technology with the experience to match, we'd love to connect.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* Overall 10+ years experience in back-end software design and development
* 8+ years experience with Java and Spring Boot frameworks
* Strong technical proficiency in designing and implementing secure, clean code in Java while upholding engineering best practices
* Extensive experience designing and implementing optimized RESTful APIs
* Proven experience with containerization using Docker and/or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
* Advanced knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, particularly using Azure DevOps
* Expert-level knowledge of agile software engineering practices
* Demonstrated experience in technical leadership, including architecture decisions, code reviews, and mentoring team members
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

* Experience with Angular and JavaScript
* Ability to partner closely with enterprise and solution architects on high-level/low-level design
* Expertise in software testing methodologies to ensure reliability and performance
* Experience with cloud-native application development on Azure
* Knowledge of microservices architecture and domain-driven design
* Experience with performance tuning and optimization of Java applications
* Proactive and collaborative mindset with a strong sense of ownership
* Willingness to go the extra mile to deliver quality solutions

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week**
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

title: Principal Engineer (.Net)
description:
**About EPS Packaging**
At ePS Packaging, we’re shaping the future of packaging through technology. As a global leader in industry-specific business and production software, we help packaging companies streamline operations, boost efficiency, and unlock growth.
  
  
With over 30 years of experience, a global footprint, and a deep understanding of the packaging industry, we believe one thing above all: our success grows when our customers thrive.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To provide technical leadership and architectural direction for the Radius product, driving the design, development, modernization, performance, scalability, and long-term technical evolution of the platform. The role requires deep expertise in .NET and enterprise application development, strong understanding of ERP/business systems, and the ability to work across engineering, product, QA, support, and customer teams to deliver high-quality business solutions.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership and architectural direction for the Radius product, ensuring solutions align with product strategy, business objectives, and long-term technology direction.
* Lead the design and development of complex product capabilities using C#, .NET 8 or above, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server.
* Define and promote scalable, maintainable, secure, and high-performance application architectures and development practices.
* Drive the modernization of the Radius platform, identifying opportunities to improve legacy components, architecture, technology stack, performance, maintainability, and developer productivity.
* Lead technical discussions and architecture reviews, evaluate alternative approaches, and make pragmatic technology and design decisions.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Product Management to understand business requirements, challenge assumptions where appropriate, identify technical implications, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership during story refinement, estimation, sprint planning, implementation, and delivery of complex initiatives.
* Act as a technical mentor and provide guidance to Senior Software Engineers and other developers through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing.
* Establish and promote engineering best practices around clean code, SOLID principles, design patterns, API design, testing, observability, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Design and optimize data access solutions using Entity Framework Core and SQL Server, including complex queries, indexing, data modelling, transactions, and database performance optimization.
* Analyze and resolve complex technical and customer issues, leading root-cause analysis and ensuring that corrective actions address underlying problems rather than only immediate symptoms.
* Support critical customer escalations and work directly with Support, Product Owners, and customers when required to understand issues and drive effective technical solutions.
* Identify product-wide technical risks, architectural limitations, technical debt, and opportunities for improvement, and proactively drive their resolution.
* Establish appropriate unit testing, automated testing, CI/CD, and quality practices to improve product reliability and reduce regression risk.
* Contribute to the evolution of CI/CD and DevOps practices, build automation, deployment processes, and engineering productivity.
* Provide technical guidance on Docker, containerization, cloud technologies, and cloud-native application practices.
* Provide technical guidance for frontend integration and Angular-based applications where required.
* Promote effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and similar technologies to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, debugging, documentation, and solution exploration.
* Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, tools, and development approaches and recommend their adoption where they provide measurable value to the Radius product.
* Work across teams and projects to ensure architectural consistency, reuse of common capabilities, and alignment with broader Packaging Suite technology direction.
* Participate in technical planning for major releases, modernization initiatives, customer-driven enhancements, and strategic product investments.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation including architecture decisions, design specifications, API documentation, technical standards, and implementation guidelines.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement across development, testing, deployment, and support activities.
* Actively contribute to building a strong engineering culture through mentoring, knowledge sharing, technical standards, and continuous improvement.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 10–12 years of hands-on software development experience, with significant experience in enterprise application development using C#, .NET / .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core.
* Strong hands-on experience with .NET 8 or above and modern .NET application architecture and development practices.
* Extensive experience developing RESTful Web APIs, backend services, and enterprise applications using ASP.NET Core.
* Strong expertise in Entity Framework Core, including LINQ, relationships, query optimization, transactions, migrations, and efficient data access patterns.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, complex SQL queries, stored procedures, indexing, execution plans, performance tuning, and troubleshooting database-related issues.
* Proven experience designing scalable, high-performance, and maintainable enterprise application architectures.
* Strong understanding and practical application of SOLID principles, design patterns, clean architecture, API design, dependency injection, and software engineering best practices.
* Strong experience with unit testing, automated testing, testability, and quality engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, build automation, and software delivery practices.
* Experience with Docker and containerized applications and a good understanding of container-based application architecture.
* Experience with cloud technologies and cloud-based application development is desirable.
* Experience with Angular / TypeScript or modern frontend technologies is a plus.
* Experience working with ERP, manufacturing, business management, or other complex enterprise applications is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience in technical leadership and architecture, with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.
* Proven ability to analyze complex technical problems, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and drive solutions through to completion.
* Strong experience in application, API, and database performance optimization.
* Experience working with large and/or complex legacy codebases and leading modernization initiatives.
* Strong understanding of software architecture principles, distributed systems, integration patterns, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Ability to assess technical debt and establish pragmatic strategies for balancing new feature development, modernization, stability, and technical debt reduction.
* Proficiency in using AI-assisted development tools effectively for coding, code analysis, debugging, testing, documentation, and technical problem solving.
* Ability to quickly understand complex business domains and translate business requirements into robust technical architectures and solutions.
* Strong ownership and leadership mindset, with the ability to work independently and take accountability for technically complex initiatives.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively without relying solely on formal authority.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to developers, Product Owners, management, Support teams, and customers.
* Ability to balance business priorities, delivery timelines, technical quality, scalability, maintainability, and long-term product strategy.

At ePS, you’ll be part of a global, collaborative, and forward-thinking team that’s redefining what’s possible in the packaging industry. We foster an inclusive workplace where diversity drives innovation and every team member’s voice is valued. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact, helping our customers operate smarter and succeed sustainably.
  
  
Join us and help build the future of packaging technology.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Staff Lead Software Engineer (AI-Native)

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment: Full-time · Early-stage, founder-led company

Compensation: As per Market Standards for this role

About Us

We are an early-stage company building applied AI products for complex professional workflows, including healthcare and legal.

Our focus is practical: software that professionals can trust and use in their daily work. That requires more than an impressive AI demo—it requires reliable engineering, thoughtful user experiences, strong data foundations, and disciplined validation.

We operate with a small team, direct founder involvement, and AI-assisted development as standard practice. Specific product details will be shared during the interview process.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can own multiple AI products end-to-end—not just an AI component, backend service, or prototype.

You will take products from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. The work spans AI-powered applications, voice and document workflows, knowledge systems, and the shared infrastructure supporting them.

You will work directly with the founder, who leads product direction, priorities, and customer requirements. You will own engineering execution and technical decisions, enabling the founder to focus on product rather than daily code reviews, debugging, and integration management.

This is a player-coach role: you will write production code, lead a small engineering team, and remain accountable for whether the complete product actually works.

What You Will Own

* End-to-end product delivery. Turn product requirements into working applications across the frontend, backend, AI layer, data systems, and infrastructure. Own the complete user journey—not merely whether individual components run.
* Architecture and technical decisions. Choose appropriate technologies, define clear interfaces, and make practical build-versus-buy decisions. Build reusable capabilities across products without creating unnecessary abstraction or complexity.
* Applied AI engineering. Build and integrate LLM-powered features, retrieval and knowledge workflows, structured outputs, and speech or voice capabilities. Know when to use a model, conventional software, deterministic validation, or human review.
* Independent verification and release quality. Establish automated tests, AI evaluation suites, regression checks, and end-to-end acceptance tests. Reproduce failures, investigate root causes, and demonstrate fixes with evidence. Establish effective code review and quality gates without relying on the founder as the default reviewer.
* Reliable data and production systems. Turn imperfect source data into validated, traceable, versioned datasets and services. Own deployment, observability, error handling, recovery, latency, and operating costs.
* Security and responsible implementation. Build appropriate access controls, sensitive-data handling, audit trails, and safeguards. Work with domain experts to translate professional requirements into testable engineering behavior.
* Team leadership and execution. Break work into achievable milestones, delegate clearly, review critical changes, mentor engineers, and resolve integration blockers. Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs early—with working demonstrations and honest quality results.

What We Are Looking For

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 4+ years owning architecture and technical decisions for production systems and 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers.
* Demonstrated full-stack ownership. You have personally delivered complete products across APIs, databases, user interfaces, integrations, and cloud infrastructure—not only contributed to a narrow layer.
* Production AI experience. You have shipped at least two AI/LLM-powered products or substantial features into real use. You can explain the reliability, evaluation, latency, cost, and operational trade-offs you encountered.
* Strong implementation skills. Expert-level Python, strong React/TypeScript, solid SQL and data-modeling skills, and hands-on experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, and security fundamentals.
* Evidence of self-verification. You can show or explain a test or evaluation system you built, the failures it caught, and how you determined that a release was ready.
* Practical AI-native development experience. You actively use tools such as Claude Code or equivalent to accelerate delivery, while independently reviewing, testing, and taking responsibility for the resulting code.
* Independent engineering judgment. You can work through incomplete requirements, inspect actual data before making assumptions, diagnose unfamiliar failures, and make sensible decisions without constant technical supervision.

Experience That Helps

Healthcare or legal experience is valuable, but not mandatory. Relevant experience includes:

* Healthcare software, clinical workflows, EHR/EMR integrations, or applications handling sensitive health information.
* Legal technology, law-firm workflows, document-heavy professional systems, or confidential client information.
* Speech and voice products, including streaming transcription, speaker separation, multilingual audio, or code-switching.
* Founding-engineer roles, small-team product ownership, or products built for the Indian market.

Our Technical Environment

Backend and data: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, vector search, Redis.

AI: LLM APIs, retrieval/RAG, structured outputs, evaluation frameworks, and speech integrations.

Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Infrastructure: Cloud services, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and automated quality gates.

Development: AI-assisted coding, supported by engineering review and testing.

You do not need prior experience with every tool. You do need the depth to own the system and learn unfamiliar parts without making the founder the integration layer.

What Success Looks Like

Products work end-to-end in realistic user workflows—not just in isolated demos. Releases are supported by reproducible tests and meaningful quality evidence. Failures are identified and addressed before customers or the founder become the primary testers.

The team delivers against clear milestones, raises risks early, and improves its ability to work independently. The founder can focus on what to build and why, while trusting you to lead how it is built, verified, and operated.

What We Offer

Staff-level scope across multiple products, direct partnership with the founder, and the opportunity to shape architecture, engineering standards, and a growing team.

You will have substantial technical ownership and a hands-on role in turning early products into dependable production systems.

How to Apply

Send your résumé or LinkedIn profile to dinesh@astroum.ai, along with brief answers to these three questions:

1. What is a production system you personally owned end-to-end? Explain what you built, the decisions you made, and one decision you would change today.
2. How do you verify your work without depending on someone else to catch your mistakes? Describe a test or evaluation harness you built, a serious failure it caught, and how you verified the fix.
3. What have you recently shipped using AI-assisted development? Explain how you used the tools, where their output was wrong or incomplete, and how you made the final result production-ready.

* Public code, demos, or architecture examples are welcome but not required. Anonymized examples are fine; please do not share confidential employer or client material.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Lead Software Engineer (AI-Native)

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment: Full-time · Early-stage, founder-led company

Compensation: As per Market Standards for this role

About Us

We are an early-stage company building applied AI products for complex professional workflows, including healthcare and legal.

Our focus is practical: software that professionals can trust and use in their daily work. That requires more than an impressive AI demo—it requires reliable engineering, thoughtful user experiences, strong data foundations, and disciplined validation.

We operate with a small team, direct founder involvement, and AI-assisted development as standard practice. Specific product details will be shared during the interview process.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can own multiple AI products end-to-end—not just an AI component, backend service, or prototype.

You will take products from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. The work spans AI-powered applications, voice and document workflows, knowledge systems, and the shared infrastructure supporting them.

You will work directly with the founder, who leads product direction, priorities, and customer requirements. You will own engineering execution and technical decisions, enabling the founder to focus on product rather than daily code reviews, debugging, and integration management.

This is a player-coach role: you will write production code, lead a small engineering team, and remain accountable for whether the complete product actually works.

What You Will Own

* End-to-end product delivery. Turn product requirements into working applications across the frontend, backend, AI layer, data systems, and infrastructure. Own the complete user journey—not merely whether individual components run.
* Architecture and technical decisions. Choose appropriate technologies, define clear interfaces, and make practical build-versus-buy decisions. Build reusable capabilities across products without creating unnecessary abstraction or complexity.
* Applied AI engineering. Build and integrate LLM-powered features, retrieval and knowledge workflows, structured outputs, and speech or voice capabilities. Know when to use a model, conventional software, deterministic validation, or human review.
* Independent verification and release quality. Establish automated tests, AI evaluation suites, regression checks, and end-to-end acceptance tests. Reproduce failures, investigate root causes, and demonstrate fixes with evidence. Establish effective code review and quality gates without relying on the founder as the default reviewer.
* Reliable data and production systems. Turn imperfect source data into validated, traceable, versioned datasets and services. Own deployment, observability, error handling, recovery, latency, and operating costs.
* Security and responsible implementation. Build appropriate access controls, sensitive-data handling, audit trails, and safeguards. Work with domain experts to translate professional requirements into testable engineering behavior.
* Team leadership and execution. Break work into achievable milestones, delegate clearly, review critical changes, mentor engineers, and resolve integration blockers. Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs early—with working demonstrations and honest quality results.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 4+ years owning architecture and technical decisions for production systems and 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers.
* Demonstrated full-stack ownership. You have personally delivered complete products across APIs, databases, user interfaces, integrations, and cloud infrastructure—not only contributed to a narrow layer.
* Production AI experience. You have shipped at least two AI/LLM-powered products or substantial features into real use. You can explain the reliability, evaluation, latency, cost, and operational trade-offs you encountered.
* Strong implementation skills. Expert-level Python, strong React/TypeScript, solid SQL and data-modeling skills, and hands-on experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, and security fundamentals.
* Evidence of self-verification. You can show or explain a test or evaluation system you built, the failures it caught, and how you determined that a release was ready.
* Practical AI-native development experience. You actively use tools such as Claude Code or equivalent to accelerate delivery, while independently reviewing, testing, and taking responsibility for the resulting code.
* Independent engineering judgment. You can work through incomplete requirements, inspect actual data before making assumptions, diagnose unfamiliar failures, and make sensible decisions without constant technical supervision.

**Experience That Helps**

**Healthcare or legal experience is valuable, but not mandatory. Relevant experience includes:**

* Healthcare software, clinical workflows, EHR/EMR integrations, or applications handling sensitive health information.
* Legal technology, law-firm workflows, document-heavy professional systems, or confidential client information.
* Speech and voice products, including streaming transcription, speaker separation, multilingual audio, or code-switching.
* Founding-engineer roles, small-team product ownership, or products built for the Indian market.

**Our Technical Environment**

**Backend and data: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, vector search, Redis.**

**AI: LLM APIs, retrieval/RAG, structured outputs, evaluation frameworks, and speech integrations.**

**Frontend: React and TypeScript.**

**Infrastructure: Cloud services, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and automated quality gates.**

**Development: AI-assisted coding, supported by engineering review and testing.**

**You do not need prior experience with every tool. You do need the depth to own the system and learn unfamiliar parts without making the founder the integration layer.**

**What Success Looks Like**

**Products work end-to-end in realistic user workflows—not just in isolated demos. Releases are supported by reproducible tests and meaningful quality evidence. Failures are identified and addressed before customers or the founder become the primary testers.**

**The team delivers against clear milestones, raises risks early, and improves its ability to work independently. The founder can focus on what to build and why, while trusting you to lead how it is built, verified, and operated.**

**What We Offer**

**Staff-level scope across multiple products, direct partnership with the founder, and the opportunity to shape architecture, engineering standards, and a growing team.**

**You will have substantial technical ownership and a hands-on role in turning early products into dependable production systems.**

**How to Apply**

**Send your résumé or LinkedIn profile to dinesh@astroum.ai, along with brief answers to these three questions:**

1. What is a production system you personally owned end-to-end? Explain what you built, the decisions you made, and one decision you would change today.
2. How do you verify your work without depending on someone else to catch your mistakes? Describe a test or evaluation harness you built, a serious failure it caught, and how you verified the fix.
3. What have you recently shipped using AI-assisted development? Explain how you used the tools, where their output was wrong or incomplete, and how you made the final result production-ready.

* Public code, demos, or architecture examples are welcome but not required. Anonymized examples are fine; please do not share confidential employer or client material.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
**Role: Java Architect**

**Experience: 8-15 years**

**Location: Chennai (Nungambakkam) - WFO**

**Skills: Architect, Java, Spring boot, Spring Security, CI/CD,**

**Domain: FINTECH (MANDATORY)**

JD:

Key Responsibilities:

1. 2. 3. Architecture & Product Design • Own end-to-end architecture for high-throughput, low-latency services and user-facing apps; define APIs, data models, caching, partitioning/sharding, and event flows. • Translate product requirements into architectural roadmaps and component designs (domain-driven design, microservices, API-first). • Drive “secure-by-default” patterns (Zero-Trust, principle of least privilege) and privacy-first data design. Full-Stack Engineering (Java-First) • Build backend services in Java/Spring Boot; design REST/gRPC APIs, asynchronous pipelines, and distributed workflows. • Contribute to front-end (React/Next or similar) and shared libraries; ensure cohesive UX with strong performance budgets and accessibility. • Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevEx improvements (build speed, quality gates, developer tooling). High-Frequency Transaction Systems • Design for throughput, concurrency, and fault-tolerance (bulkheads, circuit breakers, idempotency, retry/backoff, message ordering). • Performance tune JVM, thread pools, GC, connection pools; establish SLOs and p95/p99 latency targets. • Introduce event streaming, queues, and exactly-once/at-least-once semantics where applicable. 4. 5. 6. Security & Compliance • Champion IAM/CIAM/IGA patterns (OAuth2/OIDC, SAML), secrets management, KMS, and robust RBAC/ABAC. • Partner with Security to embed threat modelling, secure coding, and automated security testing in the SDLC. Reliability & Observability • Define SLO/SLI/SLA, golden signals, and error budgets; implement tracing/metrics/logging dashboards (ELK/Grafana/OpenTelemetry). • Lead incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and resilience tests (chaos, failover, DR). Leadership & Collaboration • Mentor senior engineers; review designs/PRs; raise engineering bar via patterns, documentation, and standards. • Collaborate with Product on discovery, scoping, and MVP slicing; influence build-vs-buy and cost/perf trade-offs.

Qualifications & experience:

• 10+ years in software engineering with strong Java and Spring depth; proven full-stack delivery.

• Experience in designing/developing high availability and high scalability systems preferably on cloud.

• Experience in design heavy transaction management systems with both db and streaming services like Kafka and other cloud event hubs

• Experience in designing and executing DR planning and recovery.

• Experience in Blue/Green deployments and canary deployments is an added advantage.

• Demonstrated ownership designing high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems in production (≥ millions of requests/events/day).

• Hands-on experience with microservices, API-first architectures, caching strategies, and transaction integrity (idempotency, dedup).

• Solid grasp of cloud-native design (AWS preferred), containers/K8s, CI/CD, and infrastructure reliability

. • Strong understanding of security for web and APIs (authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection).

• Excellent system design skills and ability to influence architecture across teams.

• Background in BFSI, payments, or cybersecurity platforms preferred

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Senior AI/ML Developer

Location: Coimbatore

Experience: 4+ Years

Notice: 30 Days

The Mission: Building the Intelligence Layer for Financial Operations Anaiyan is building intelligent systems that transform complex, fragmented financial and operational data into reliable, structured and actionable information. We are working at the intersection of AI/ML, financial data, accounting, automation and agentic systems—solving problems where traditional rules-based software struggles with ambiguity, variability and context. Our systems need to understand real-world data from sources such as POS systems, bank statements, CRM/ERP exports, spreadsheets, invoices and accounting systems; identify relationships between records; infer transformations; reconcile financial events; and progressively learn from human decisions. We are looking for an engineer who wants to solve difficult problems in machine learning, LLMs, document/data understanding, reasoning, evaluation and production AI systems. If you enjoy taking an ambiguous problem, determining where AI actually adds value, building the system, measuring its behaviour and making it reliable enough for production, this is the environment you’ve been looking for.

Core Responsibilities

AI/ML System Development Design and develop production-grade AI/ML systems for financial and operational workflows. Work across: • LLM-based systems • Machine learning and deep learning • Classification and prediction • Semantic search & Anomaly detection • Recommendation and ranking • Structured reasoning Build hybrid systems combining deterministic rules, statistical models, embeddings and LLMs where appropriate. Agentic AI Systems Design and implement controlled AI agents for complex financial workflows. Build reliable agent architectures with: • Tool calling • State management • Planning • Context management • Verification • Confidence assessment • Human-in-the-loop controls • Retry and recovery mechanisms • Auditability LLM Engineering Work with leading foundation models and develop production applications using: • Structured generation • Function/tool calling • RAG • Embeddings • Prompt/context engineering • Model evaluation & routing • Fine-tuning • Cost and latency optimization Evaluate when a problem should be solved using an LLM versus conventional ML, deterministic logic or a hybrid approach. AI Evaluation & Reliability Build rigorous evaluation frameworks for AI systems. Define and measure: • Precision/recall • Classification accuracy • False-positive/false-negative rates • Confidence calibration • LLM response quality • Agent task completion • Regression performance Build representative synthetic and real-world evaluation datasets and automated regression suites.

Technical & Professional Qualifications

AI/ML Engineering Experience — 4+ years in ML engineering & AI engineering, with significant hands-on experience building and deploying production AI/ML systems. LLM & Generative AI Expertise — strong hands-on experience with modern LLM application development, including several of: OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph, Pydantic AI, agent frameworks, structured outputs, tool/function calling, RAG, embeddings and LLM evaluation. Machine Learning Depth — strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, ranking, clustering, similarity/matching, NLP, information extraction, deep learning, model evaluation and statistical reasoning. Hands-on experience with PyTorch, scikit-learn or equivalent ML frameworks. Data & Backend Engineering — strong Python development skills and practical experience with SQL, PostgreSQL or equivalent databases, REST APIs, data pipelines, model/version management, Pandas/NumPy, JSON/CSV/Excel processing, Docker, Git and automated testing. Experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures is valuable. AI/ML Production Engineering — experience deploying and operating AI/ML systems in production, with knowledge of model serving, MLOps/LLMOps, model/version management, observability, inference optimization, GPU/compute optimization, CI/CD, containerization and cloud infrastructure. Analytical Thinking — strong ability to break ambiguous problems into measurable components and determine the appropriate combination of rules, ML, LLMs, agents and human review, rather than defaulting to a single technology.

Who Should Apply This role is particularly suited for engineers who:

• Build systems and enjoy working with messy real-world data. • Are comfortable combining conventional engineering with AI. • Care deeply about evaluation and correctness. • Can reason about AI failure modes. • Are excited by agentic systems but understand their limitations. • Want to work on difficult financial-data problems. • Prefer solving open-ended problems over implementing predetermined specifications.
